scientific_intent.scientific_task: Normalize finite logit rows into probability vectors with a numerically stable two-pass online softmax.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: p_j=exp(x_j-max(x))/sum_k exp(x_k-max(x)); online per-lane maximum/sum state, shared maximum and sum trees, second global scan writes normalized probabilities.
scientific_intent.discretization: Five (rows,columns) shapes (17,1),(19,31),(33,33),(17,257),(3,50257), each across original32/64/128/256/512/1024thread block sizes; selected nativekernel4 only.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Full941010 probabilities plus510 guards per artifact; exact156936Float32 inputprefix. Original1e-4+eps(Float32)*abs(ref), Float64 oracle, finite/nonnegative/probability bounds, rowmass1e-5, bit-exact pairedrow shift invariance; all20 artifacts.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Stable normalization of model logits, including vocabulary-width rows. This is an isolated operator, not model training/inference accuracy or full decoder throughput.
scientific_intent.description: Genuine historical Julia uses a valid three-pass max/sum/write algorithm rather than requested source online kernel variants. Preserve it, adapt the current reference to original block-online kernel4, translate that same algorithm to KA then JACC. Native GPU body unchanged.
scientific_intent.provenance: Source reviewed; no application dataset provenance inferred. Seeded dyadic inputs with uniform rows, finite ±1000 shifts, outliers and pointmass controls; paired rows are controlled invariance cases, not independent samples.
